label: sdc01_0380_npc_key_01
text: I saw Fezandipiti zoom through the sky over\nOni Mountain!\c\nIt was so much cooler than the stories say!

label: sdc01_0380_npc_key_02
text: Have you seen Okidogi of the Loyal Three?\nThat purple scarf it wears is so lovely!\c\nI saw it wandering around in the barrens!

label: sdc01_0380_npc_key_03
text:
I thought someone had collapsed, so I went to
check on them, but it was just Munkidori taking
a nap! It can be so peaceful around that pond
out there. What an ideal place for a snooze!

label: sdc01_0380_system_02
text: You got a clue to the Loyal Three’s whereabouts!

label: sdc01_0380_system_03
text: You got a second clue to the Loyal Three’s\nwhereabouts!

label: sdc01_0380_system_01
text: You got clues to all of the Loyal Three’s\nwhereabouts! Time to compare notes!

label: sdc01_0380_sister_01
text: We need to gather every scrap of info we can\nget about any sightings of the Lousy Three!\r\nLet’s meet up once we’re done![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0380_brother_01
text: I-I’m not big on goin’ up and just talkin’ to\npeople, even if we’re all from the same village...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
